result:
M03 (Habits) round 1 is a **PASS**. Every check passed on the real stack, and I made no fixes and raised no FIX tasks.

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| Code review (git diff HEAD + untracked files) | Pass. All backend tasks T031–T038 and frontend tasks T039–T044 really exist in the code, and they follow the contract and the constitution. |
| Swagger vs contract | Pass |
| `./mvnw -q verify` | Pass, 101 tests with 0 failures |
| curl regression up to M03 | Pass on a fresh database: M01 6/6, M02 14/14, M03 13/13 |
| M03 browser scenarios E2E-M03-01..07 | Pass |
| Backend-down error state | Pass |
| Smoke scenarios E2E-M01-01 and E2E-M02-01 | Pass |

- **Browser scenarios:** the empty state on the fresh database, name validation (empty and 151 characters), adding daily and weekly habits, marking done and undoing, and edit, deactivate and delete. The "Already completed" message was checked against a real 409 from the backend.
- **First curl run:** it failed one case, AC-M01-01, which expects settings to be unconfigured. The browser had already saved settings when it first loaded, so this is not a code defect. After restarting the backend on a fresh database, every suite passed.
- **Console errors:** the only error lines in the browser console are Chromium logging expected responses: the intended 409, a 404 from my own check after the delete, and 500s while I had stopped the backend on purpose. None come from the application.
- **Backend state:** I stopped the backend to test the error state and restarted it on the same database; it is healthy on :8090.
- **Blocked command:** one combined `cat` of several files using `{a,b}` brace syntax was denied by the headless permissions. I read the files separately instead, and noted the limitation in the handoff.
- **Screenshots:** the Playwright tool can only save them under `run-artifacts/playwright/` (named `verify-M03-r1-*`), so they are referenced there rather than copied into the round's evidence folder.

Nothing was committed. Files are in `loops/verify/`:
- `outputs/M03-round-1.md`
- `outputs/evidence/M03/round-1/` (`swagger-diff.md`, `curl.log`, `e2e-result.md`)
- `progress.md`
- `state/handoff.md`
